author: reek
body: Intel HDA audio output driver for the browser. Writes decoded PCM samples to the Intel HDA controller emulated by codex-vm.

author: reek
body: codex-vm simplifies this: the HDA controller auto-configures codec 0 with a single output converter, and the BDL can be a single buffer. The controller DMA-reads PCM and outputs via the host's waveOut API.
